description: Offre de transports Sibra à Annecy (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Sibra. Réseau Sibra du Grand Annecy: 20 lignes urbaines 9 lignes interurbaines TAD Zonal via SIBRA A LA DEMANDE \~15 Lignes saisonnières hivernales et estivales Mise à jour avec les lignes saisonnières estivales. \\ MAJ le 17/06/2026, horaires valables du 17/06/2026 au 30/08/2026 inclus.\\. Coverage: Sibra. The portal shows the English title as "Sibra transport offer in Annecy (GTFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Sibra. Its keywords include annecy, interurbains, urbains, grand-annecy, sibra, bus. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-06-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
